notes.title: Version 1.0.7 Update: UI Improvements and Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello Players,

We appreciate your dedication and valuable feedback! Your contributions are essential in our mission to refine and enhance the game experience.

We’re excited to share that version 1.0.7 is now live, featuring improvements and fixes:
[list]
[*]UI Update 1: The interface now displays items you find on the ground.
[*]UI Update 2: You can now see items you steal from corpses in your inventory.
[*]Inventory Bug Fix: Resolved an issue where the necessary amount of money would be deducted even if your inventory was full.
[*]Spawning Bug Fix: Addressed a bug present in the Epic version where quest items would not spawn after day 21.
[*]Camera Clip Fix: Fixed a camera issue that would cause it to clip to the river when exiting the apothecary.
[*]Updated Credits: The main menu credits section has been refreshed to include Steam users who assisted by reporting bugs and contributing with suggestions.
[*]Saving Events Optimization: Enhanced the saving process for quicker save progress.
[*]Overall Camera Adjustment: Adjusted camera settings.
[/list]

We appreciate your patience as we work to improve the game. 
Please join our Discord channel to be part of our growing community and to stay in the loop about any news regarding the game: 
[url=https://discord.com/invite/mEqJJySDyw style=button] Discord [/url]

As always, these updates apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.
[url=https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/plague-london-1665-203017 style=button] Epic [/url]
[url=https://www.gog.com/en/game/plague_london_1665 style=button] GOG [/url]

Thank you for being an essential part of our community. We hope you enjoy your continued adventures in the streets of London!

notes.title: Game Update v1.0.6: New Features, Fixes, and Temporary Cart Bug Solution!
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you once again for your continued support and valuable feedback. Your insights are helping us improve the game, and we appreciate every contribution!

We’re excited to announce that the game has been updated to version 1.0.6, bringing several important updates and fixes: 
[list] 
[*] In-Game Menu: You can now access the city map from the in-game menu. 
[*] Spelling Fixes: Various spelling issues throughout the game have been addressed. 
[*] Updated Credits: The main menu credits section has been updated to include Steam users who helped by reporting bugs. 
[*] Cart Collider Bug: We’ve fixed a bug where the cart collider was causing issues. 
[*] Loading Bug: Fixed an issue where the cart collider would get stuck during loading. 
[*] New Loading Tips: Enjoy some fresh tips while your game loads. 
[/list]

Additionally, a more comprehensive update will be coming next week. The cart fixes in this version are temporary but were the quickest way to resolve the issue for now. A more permanent cart system fix is in development and will be released next week to ensure a smoother gameplay experience.

Note: These changes apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.

Thank you for being a part of our community and helping us make the game better! 
Enjoy your adventures in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Version 1.0.4 - Updates and Fixes
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Thank you all for playing our game, and a special thanks to those who report any issues, bugs, or strange behavior. Even if something isn't a bug, we are more than happy to look into anything that's reported, so please don’t hesitate to reach out if you suspect something is off.

The current active game version is now 1.0.4, and the fixes and updates it includes are as follows:
[list]
[*] Multi-collider interaction between carts, normal corpses, and wrapped corpses no longer causes a procedural bug.
[*] Some users were able to exploit the task generation system, which is now fixed.
[*] World adjustment system is no longer accessible.
[*] Markets and sellers no longer allow players to leave until the conversation is completed.
[*] Credits section updated.
[*] Save slot font size updated to display AM/PM.
[*] Notification added for blocked areas.
[*] Audio listeners disabled in the persistent game scene.
[/list]
We hope these fixes improve your overall experience. ❤️

Note: These changes apply to all versions of the game on Steam, Epic, and GOG.

Important: These fixes unfortunately do not affect save files from the previous version, so they are likely to be corrupted if the bug you experienced was procedural. Otherwise, your save files should be fine.

Thank you again for your amazing support, and stay safe in the streets of London.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/

notes.title: Everything You Need to Know: Story, Demo, Release 🎉📅
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Dear Plague: London 1665 Enthusiasts,[/b][/h1]

We're excited to provide a development update on Plague: London 1665 and share our plans for the year, including the game's upcoming release. 
[b][u]Your support means the world to us, and we can't wait to share this historical journey with you.[/u][/b]

Plague: London 1665 has been in development since 2022, with all aspects, including art, development, music, and marketing, handled in-house. We've reached a point where we feel confident enough to focus on stabilizing the in-game economy and start preparing the game for release.

[h2]📚 Story:[/h2]
As we approach the release, we're admittedly a bit nervous about how the game will be received. The narrative closely follows the events of a family during the outbreak of the bubonic plague in London. We were initially divided on how to present the story, but ultimately decided that telling the family's events exactly as they occurred was crucial. 
Plague: London 1665 is a game based on researched and documented events, offering players an authentic glimpse into the summer of 1665.

We hope players will appreciate the game for what it is.

Please join our Discord channel to be part of our growing community and to stay in the loop about any news regarding the game: [url=https://discord.com/invite/mEqJJySDyw][b]https://discord.com/invite/mEqJJySDyw[/b][/url]

[h2]🎮 Demo:[/h2]
To encourage players to experience our game and provide valuable feedback, we're planning to release a short demo version of Plague: London 1665 in April or May 2024. Therefore, we invite you to stay tuned and witness our game.

[h2]🎉 Steam Next Fest:[/h2]
Additionally, we've entered Steam Next Fest, scheduled for June this year. Keep an eye on our Steam Page for more announcements, and join our game streaming sessions during the event days.

[h2]📅 Release Date:[/h2]
While we're still uncertain about the exact release date, the game's development cycle is nearing it's completion, and we're confident it will be released sometime this year. Unfortunately, we cannot commit to an exact date at this moment.

Stay tuned for more updates and thank you for your support on this historical journey through [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2225010/Plague_London_1665/][b]Plague: London 1665![/b][/url]
